name: io.github.raksa/open-lyric-mcp
title: Open Lyric
description: Validate, transpose, edit, render and export songs written in Open Lyric notation.

environmentVariables.name: OPEN_LYRIC_MCP_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Folders the file tools may use, besides the client's roots — a path list (':'-separated; ';' on Windows). With neither, the working directory.

environmentVariables.name: OPEN_LYRIC_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to never write a file: edits return the new text instead.
